legacySignedSynergyOverflow.policy: Extreme combinations exceed signed32 multiplication in legacy getters. Modern behavior unverified; native must not claim equivalence beyond that boundary.

Ground386 has explicit Skill251 and SrcDam0, so its fresh creator uses retained rank and current supplied five-hard-synergy total/fire mastery; weapon physical/item elemental/poison/leech/critical and origin damage are excluded.

Below the explicitly enumerated signed32 overflow boundary, full skill endpoints apply HitShift7, then11percent per total hard synergy point, then fire mastery, with integer truncation at each source layer. Twelve tier-boundary/rank255 contexts are checked with0/1/20/100 total hard points and0/25/50 mastery.

services: Hard-point/formula lookup, owner/weapon/item stats, ratio and metadata/type helpers and empty monster-type stat copy are declared services inherited from the checked creator harness. Full getters, tier/mastery helpers, creator/add/scale and setter execute unchanged.
